Christmas dinner for two in Hongdae, Hapjeong and Sangsu

Planning a Christmas date over pizza and pasta? At 홍대화덕피자, look through the menu, actual dining-room photos, walking directions and availability for your chosen date.

Choosing your dishes

If you prefer different toppings, consider a half-and-half pizza. Quattro Stagioni offers a variety of toppings. Quattro Formaggi combines Gorgonzola, cream cheese, Reggiano and mozzarella. Gamberi Crema is a spicy shrimp cream pasta with cheese melted in the oven. Gamberi e Rucola is an oil-based pasta with shrimp and arugula. Choose according to your tastes and appetites.

Check the current menu

Check the latest menu and prices on Naver Place using the menu button below. Confirm the Christmas menu and any date-specific arrangements with the restaurant before visiting.

See the actual dining space

The photo shows the actual restaurant. Check the dining-room photos on the homepage and ask about seating or timing requests before booking.

Check your preferred date

To check Christmas Eve or Christmas Day availability, open Naver Place with the booking button below, select its reservation button, then choose your date and party size. If the date is not open or the time you want is unavailable, contact the restaurant. Check current holiday opening hours and conditions before visiting.

Walking directions

The address is 5 Dokmak-ro 7-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, first floor. Allow about five minutes on foot from Hapjeong or Sangsu Station, or about fifteen minutes from Hongik University Station. Check the walking guide when planning your date.
